strings.Artículo divulgativo de proyecto académi: Informative article on a non-operational academic project. Real aerial activities require authorized centers, qualified pilots, insurance, regulations and favorable weather.
strings.El piloto y pasajero van en un carro mot: The pilot and passenger are in a motorized car. It is comfortable for those who prefer not to run on takeoff or are looking for a more stable and panoramic sensation.
strings.Parapente, paramotor o paratrike: difere: Paragliding, paramotor or paratrike: differences when choosing your first flight | Nómada Extremo
strings.Si quieres comodidad y despegue sentado:: If you want comfort and seated takeoff: paratrike.
strings.Si quieres recorrido costero y motor: pa: If you want coastal and motor tour: paramotor.
strings.Si quieres silencio y vuelo libre: parap: If you want silence and free flight: paragliding.
strings.Usa una vela similar al parapente, pero: It uses a sail similar to a paraglider, but with a motor on the pilot's back. It allows you to take off with more autonomy on the flat and explore coastal areas if conditions and regulations allow it.
strings.Volar no siempre significa lo mismo. Par: Flying doesn't always mean the same thing. Paragliding, paramotoring and paratrike share the sky, but they change a lot in take-off, feel, dependence on the wind and comfort.
strings.Vuelo sin motor, aprovechando ladera, té: Flight without motor, taking advantage of slope, thermal and air conditions. It is silent, very natural and depends quite a bit on the weather and take-off area.
